content.hero_body: All six conversations landed on the same Sunday, most of them short, most of them exploratory. You poked at the sidebar, tested project memory, asked for a light-theme redesign of a file, pulled up humanoid robotics data, and invented a chart for something called 'Bootschie Baatsch.' Claude worked as a quick-turn utility here — file edits, web lookups, chart generation — and you moved fast between tasks without lingering on any one.
